outcome: Rates of systemic anesthetic adjunct administration during cesarean deliveries
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean deliveries at a community hospital from 2014 to 2018
finding: Out of 1867 cesarean deliveries, 5.6% received general anesthesia and 17.8% received regional anesthesia with at least one systemic anesthetic adjunct.
mod_finding: This study found that of the cesarean deliveries analyzed, 5.6% were performed using general anesthesia, while 17.8% used regional anesthesia with at least one systemic anesthetic adjunct.
